page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock of 2.5 GHz. The configuration provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity is set at 128.0 GB, establishing a strict 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio typical of compute-centric server profiles. Hardware acceleration features include AVX-512 extensions such as AVX-512F and AVX-512 VNNI, along with standard cryptographic instruction sets. The instance includes no local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes, and provides a baseline network throughput of 20 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate clear performance distinctions between single-threaded execution and parallelized throughput. Single-core tests reveal modest per-thread capability, reflected in a Geekbench single-core score of 1017.0 and a stress-ng single-core rating of 1103.28, both falling in the lower quartile. Single-threaded compression throughput is similarly constrained, with gzip achieving 19.17 GB/sec. When fully saturated across all 64 vCPUs, performance scales effectively. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 201.55 GB/sec, placing it in the top 25 percent of tested systems. Multi-core Geekbench reaches 10572.0 and PassMark CPU score totals 38269.32, landing consistently within the middle 50 percent for parallel compute and memory throughput.

Cost efficiency for this instance is rooted in parallel compute density rather than single-core speed or massive memory provisioning. For workloads that do not require high per-thread clocks or extensive memory capacity, the 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation avoids paying for idle memory capacity. However, organizations must account for the lack of bundled local NVMe storage and the necessity of external disk provisioning.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.16xlarge is technically suitable for distributed data processing, continuous integration build pipelines, static web serving clusters, and batch rendering. Workloads requiring extreme single-threaded velocity or extensive in-memory databases will experience performance bottlenecks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor, delivering 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores and 128.0 GB of system memory. Designed with a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio, this x86_64 server is engineered for compute-heavy parallel workloads rather than memory-dense applications. The instance contains zero local disk storage, necessitating network block storage, and operates with a 20 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results reveal moderate single-thread execution rates, with Geekbench single-core scoring 1017.0, offset by capable parallel processing power, reflected in a Geekbench multi-core score of 10572.0 and top-quartile multi-threaded bzip3 decompression of 201.55 GB/sec. This instance provides a balanced resource structure for multi-threaded compilation, batch data pipelines, web tier infrastructure, and distributed microservices where high core count is required without the overhead of surplus memory.
